items.title: What's New in Iru | September 25th
items.text:
Highlights we cover this week in What's New in Iru:
MSP Billing is live, with itemized billing to increase visibility into your MSP margins
LAPS for Mac Library Item is here
Enhancements to Iru Compliance evidence collection
MacOS 27 is officially live

items.title: Recommended privacy permissions for iPhone and iPad
items.text: The Privacy Library Item now includes a Recommended privacy permissions area for iPhone and iPad, letting admins recommend the app permissions and Safari website permissions that managed apps and sites will need. The end user sees a single consent prompt listing every permission the admin recommends, with the choice to Allow all at once or select Not Now. If Not Now is selected, the app continues to prompt for individual permissions as it normally would.

items.title: Introducing MSP Billing
items.text: MSP Billing gives managed services providers daily, per-tenant spend visibility, so they always know what they owe and can bill clients with confidence. MSPs can also update payment methods, billing information, and view past invoices. It's available now for U.S. customers, with self-serve setup in minutes, right in the Partner Portal.

items.title: Windows Managed OS patch compliance
items.text: The Managed OS Library Item for Windows now reports whether each assigned device has reached the Windows 11 build the Library Item requires. Devices show as Pass, Update past due, or Error, and expanding a device row shows its current build against the required build, plus the eligibility, install enforcement, and restart enforcement dates.

items.title: Iru Agent for Windows 1.22.3
items.text: We've released Iru Agent for Windows. This release fixes Custom App and Auto App detection so apps are no longer reinstalled when a version is missing or misread, corrects Auto Apps enforcement after a user closes an app, and resolves agent installation failures.

items.title: Windows Update Library Item Recommendations in Iru AI
items.text: Iru AI can now recommend and implement Windows Update settings based on CIS benchmarks or Microsoft defaults, and you can ask follow-up questions to refine those settings or understand their behavior. Iru AI can also answer questions about most Library Items, settings, and best practices from any chat, even when you're not on that Library Item page.

items.title: Choose Where User Enrollment Invitations are Sent
items.text: Administrators can now send a Workforce Identity enrollment invitation to a user's secondary or personal email instead of their work email. This unblocks first-time enrollment for users who need a passkey to access the work mailbox that holds the invitation.

items.title: Automatic retry enrollment for Return to Service
items.text: Devices erased with Return to Service can now retry enrollment on their own if the initial attempt fails. In the Erase device modal, checking Use Return to Service reveals a new Retry enrollment option, checked by default, that's available for iPhone and iPad on iOS 27 or iPadOS 27 or later.

items.text: Highlights we cover this week in What's New in Iru:

items.title: Clearer Answers, Faster Access in Iru AI Chat
items.text: Three updates make Iru AI answers easier to read and act on.

items.title: Device health statuses for iOS and iPadOS devices
items.text: Device system health statuses for supported hardware components (such as camera, NFC, baseband, Touch ID, etc.) are now shown in Iru on the device record for supported devices running iOS or iPadOS 27 beta.

items.title: Iru Identity Directory Sync Enhancements
items.text:
Now available in Iru Identity version 2026.08.19:
Select Sync Frequency for Directory Sync Integrations - It is now possible to choose the sync frequency interval for each directory sync integration. Choices include: Manual Only, Every 30 minutes, every hour, 2 hours, 4 hours, 8 hours, 12 hours, daily, every 2 days, or weekly.
Added Refresh and Sync Now - The Sync section for each directory sync integration now features refresh and sync now buttons. This section also displays the combined information previously shown in the Activity Log and Sync sections.
Source Filter for Directory Users - Added a Source filter to the Directory Users list so you can filter users by how they were added (e.g. Manual, CSV Import).

items.title: Iru Agent for Mac Release 5.1.26 (5392)
items.text: We’ve released Iru Agent for Mac 5.1.26 (5392).

items.title: Require a managed Google Account on Android devices
items.text: Admins can now require company-owned Android devices with a work profile to be signed in with a managed Google Account, ensuring end users have full access to the organization's Google Workspace services.

items.title: Control credential managers on Android devices
items.text: Iru admins can now control which apps are allowed to act as credential managers, such as password managers and passkey providers, in the work profile on managed Android devices. The Android Restrictions Library Item includes a new Credential managers setting that sets the default policy: block all credential managers, or allow the device's pre-loaded system credential managers. Google Play app Library Items include a new Allow as credential manager option that allows a specific app, such as an approved third-party password manager, to function as a credential manager regardless of the default policy. The default policy setting requires Android 14 or later.

items.title: Enforce a specific version for Mac Auto Apps
items.text: Mac Auto Apps now support enforcing a specific version, selecting from a list of Iru hosted versions.

items.title: Single Sign On is a Few Clicks Away with More Than 200 Application Templates
items.text: Single Sign On (SSO) pre-configuration templates are now available for 209 commonly used web applications, including Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, and more! The templates guide Identity administrators through the steps needed to set up SAML or OIDC single sign-on and can also assist with SCIM user provisioning configuration. Iru is continuously adding new templates upon request, so stay tuned for more.

items.title: What's New in Iru | August 14th
items.text: Highlights we cover this week in What's New in Iu (Black Hat 2026 edition):

items.title: Update Windows apps from the system tray
items.text: Windows devices now show a list of Auto App and Custom App updates that haven't installed yet right from the new Iru system tray app. End users can install one update at a time or use Update all, closing open apps when needed to complete the install, and the list clears itself as installs succeed.

items.title: Google Cloud Platform is now available as a compliance source
items.text: Google Cloud Platform is now available in the Iru Compliance connector catalog, replacing the previous coming-soon placeholder.

items.title: Iru Agent for Mac Release 5.1.25 (5391)
items.text: We’ve released Iru Agent for Mac 5.1.25 (5391).

items.title: Filter actions by unassigned owner or delegate
items.text: The Owner and Delegate filters on the Actions list within Compliance Automation now include an Unassigned option, so admins can find the actions nobody owns yet without scanning the table. This pairs with the separate Owner and Delegate columns added in May.

items.title: Automated evidence skips document-only actions and reports failed source calls
items.text: Automated evidence turns itself off on actions that need a signed document. Iru now recognizes the actions that only a person can satisfy — a signed policy or agreement, for example — and turns off automated evidence for them instead of running a collection pass that comes back with "no evidence found." The change is recorded in the action's activity log, and you can turn automated evidence back on at any time.
